name: re_exec
title: Extract data from the first regular expression match

origin.description: Returns the first match with 1-based start and end. A missed group is an empty string at position 0.
origin.details: Returns the first match with 1-based start and end. A missed group is an empty string at position 0.
origin.value: re_exec of "  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis" returns Ben at positions 3 through 5.
origin.example:
pos <- re_exec("  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis", "(?<first>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+) (?<last>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+)")
pos$first$match

translation.description: Returns the first match with 1-based start and end. A missed group is an empty string at position 0.
translation.details: Returns the first match with 1-based start and end. A missed group is an empty string at position 0.
